evidence_quotes:
b. (All models except M1123 and “A2”
vehicles). Check all drivebelts tension
using belt tension gauge. Belt tension
should be 70 lbs (311 N) minimum. If
belt tension is not at least 70 lbs (311 N),
adjust drivebelts (paragraph 3-82). Tension
should not be greater than 110 lbs (489 N)
for new belts; old belts 95 lbs (422 N).
statements.reason: The PMCS tension procedure and its stated range are expressly limited to models other than M1123 and “A2” vehicles.
statements.statement: The general PMCS drivebelt-tension range does not apply to M1123 vehicles.

statements.reason: The PMCS procedure excludes M1123 and “A2” vehicles from its tension check and cites paragraph 3-82 for adjustment; the reference also limits paragraph 3-82 to those other vehicles.
statements.statement: Paragraph 3-82 specifies tension checks and adjustments for models other than M1123 and “A2” vehicles; M1123 vehicles are excluded.

statements.reason: The supplied reference cites paragraph 11-202 for adjusting a drivebelt, not for replacing a worn serpentine belt on M1123 vehicles.
statements.statement: For replacement of a worn serpentine belt on M1123 vehicles, the cited paragraph is 11-202.
